params.body:
## Why

On the settings screen a few values are the platform's, not the dealer's: they are merged in only for
whoever has `removebgkey.index` (`SettingsController::index()`), they are stored on a row with
`dealer_id = null`, and the pane shows them next to fields that really are per dealer. A dealer
administrator looking at the screen cannot tell the two apart, so the AI prompt add-on reads as
"my setting" while it rides along with every dealer's generated text.

This adds a marker that says whose the value is. Nothing else changes: same rights, same fields,
same routes, same storage.

## Inventory: admin-only versus per dealer

Read from the code, not from the rights table. Two facts decide it: the check that reveals the field,
and where the value is written.

**Platform-wide AND behind an administrator check (these get the marker)**

| Pane | Field | The gate | The storage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AI (`_tabs/AI.blade.php`) | `ai_vehicle_prompt` | `Auth::user()->isAdmin()` (role `BEHEERDER`), checked again in `SettingsController::updateAI()` | `Setting::where('key','ai_vehicle_prompt')->update(...)`, no dealer scope; read back with `whereNull('dealer_id')` in `VehicleTextController` |
| Achtergrond (`_tabs/removebg.blade.php`) | `api_key` (remove.bg) | `LinkHelper::rights('removebgkey.index')`, in the pane and in `updateBackground()` | `settingRepo->create(['key' => …, 'value' => …])` without `dealer_id`, so the row is `dealer_id = null` |

**Per dealer (no marker)**

- Showroom: `showroom_interval`, `with_stocklist_vehicles` — written with `dealer_id` = the caller's dealer.
- Showroomaffiche: the option order, on `dealer_has_options` per dealer.
- Website: every `website_*` field plus `default_all_vehicles` and `image_not_full_width`, through `updateCreateSetting($dealer_id, …)`.
- AI, the rest: `ai_dealer_company_info`, `ai_dealer_flexlease`, `ai_dealer_warranty`, `ai_dealer_own_commercial_text(_)` — all `updateCreateSetting($dealer_id, …)`.
- RealGarant, Transport conditions (`transport_vehicle_option_0..4`), Locaties: per dealer.

**No pane is admin-only as a whole.** Every pane in the tab bar hangs on a normal menu right
(`showroom.index`, `background.index`, `attachments.index`, `vwe.index`, `website.index`,
`setting_transport.index`, `setting_warranty.index`, `ai.index`, `location.index`); `removebgkey.index`
reveals fields only. So there is no pane heading to mark, and requirement 3 (one marker on the heading,
not per field) has nothing to apply to yet. The component supports it the moment a pane becomes
admin-only.

**Three things the inventory turned up that this PR does NOT change** (marking them "administrator only"
would be false, they are platform-wide AND editable by a dealer — each deserves its own decision):

1. `background_image` / `background_light_image` (Achtergrond pane). `saveBackgroundFile()` writes
   `settingRepo->create(['key' => $key, 'value' => $filename])` without a dealer, so the row is
   `dealer_id = null`: one pair of backgrounds for the whole platform, uploadable by any dealer with
   `background.index`. The dealer does not even see the current one (index() merges the null rows only
   for `removebgkey.index`), so the pane always offers the upload field to them.
2. `attachment` (Bijlagen pane). `updateAttachment()` writes `dealer_id => null` explicitly, same story:
   a dealer with `attachments.index` overwrites the platform pdf, and only an administrator sees the one
   that is there.
3. Transport amounts (`transport_marge`, `transport_express_price`, `transport_electronic_car`, behind
   `setting_transport.update`). They are READ dealer-scoped (`index()` plucks on the caller's
   `dealer_id`) but WRITTEN unscoped (`settingRepo->updateWhere(['key' => …], …)`, every row with that
   key), and the price table `vab_transport_vehicleclass_item_prices` has no dealer column at all. One
   of the two sides is wrong; which one is a product question, so no marker and no change here.

## What the marker is

- `.ui-badge--scope` in `refresh.css`: the existing `ui-badge` pill in the register of `ui-field-help`
  (12px, `--brand-faint` on `--brand-line-soft`, weight 500 instead of 600). Quiet, not alarming: it
  states scope, it does not warn. `x-ui.badge` accepts `variant="scope"` (the `ui-badge--` family is
  already in the dynamic prefixes of `StylesheetSyntaxTest`).
- `x-ui.field` gets a `scope` prop that renders that badge next to the field label. For a whole
  admin-only pane the same badge goes on the pane heading; there is no such pane today (see above).
- Text `alleen beheerder` (`settings.admin_only`), translated in the five languages the screen uses:
  nl / en / fr / de / es.
- The AI prompt add-on also gets one line of help under the field (`settings.ai_vehicle_prompt_help`):
  it says the instruction belongs to the platform and not to this dealer.

**On PR 288 (the prompt semantics).** That one landed while this was being written, and this branch is
rebased on it: the label now reads "AI-promptaanvulling (enkel beschrijving eigen wagenpark)", so WHAT
the field does is said by the label and the help line here says only WHOSE it is — worded to match the
landed behaviour (the instruction rides along with the own-fleet description of every dealer). If the
semantics move again, that one sentence is the only thing to follow.

## Screenshots

Before and after at 1280 and 390, in the scratchpad:
`adminlabel-{before,after}-ai-{1280,390}.png` (the AI pane) and
`adminlabel-{before,after}-remove-bg-{1280,390}.png` (the remove.bg key in the Achtergrond pane).

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on all 415 compiled views: clean.
- `npm run build`: clean.
- `php artisan test --filter='SmokeTest|SettingsTab|Settings|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest'`:
  153 tests, 962 assertions, green — on a dedicated MySQL database loaded from
  `database/schema/mysql-schema.sql` plus the post-2026-07-28 migrations, as CI does, dropped afterwards.
- New: `tests/Feature/SettingsAdminOnlyMarkerTest.php` — the marker shows for an administrator on the
  AI prompt and on the remove.bg key; a user with the AI pane but without the administrator role sees
  the pane and neither the field nor the marker; a user without `ai.index` does not see the pane at all
  (behaviour unchanged).
params.title: Settings: a quiet marker on the administrator-only settings
